angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 660,219 km at 75.27 pc = 0.12 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 13.2847 +/- 0.0127 mas (same row, RUWE 0.98): 75.27 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.949 +/- 0.008 solar radii from Georgieva et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-733 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...674A.117G/abstract): 660,219 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.956 +/- 0.05 solar masses from Georgieva et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-733 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...674A.117G/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5585 +/- 60 K from Georgieva et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-733 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...674A.117G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Georgieva et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-733 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...674A.117G/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-733.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.464, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-733 (pscomppars): spectral type G, from Georgieva et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...674A.117G/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, CD-40 6169: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-733 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.04 dex, from Georgieva et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...674A.117G/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-733 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.08619, from Georgieva et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...674A.117G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-733 (pscomppars): age 4.4 Gyr, from Georgieva et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...674A.117G/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-733 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.2 km/s, from Georgieva et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...674A.117G/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
